scope: Optional art resources. No shop/equip integration.

abyssal.name: Abyssal
abyssal.description: Deep-ocean armor, pearl lenses, bright photophore chains and delicate sensory tendrils.

crystalborn.name: Crystalborn
crystalborn.description: Faceted amethyst armor, mint-quartz growths and angular crystal crownlets.

entries.name: Sardine
features: Paired bright photophore chains fitted to the actual hull
Pearl-tipped sensory tendrils sweep away from the species head
Short swept sensory barbels
Opaque painted and pearl-like accents; no emission or transparency shader

entries.name: Sardine
features: True flat-shaded hexagonal and pentagonal crystal prisms
Paired mineral growths follow the body and preserve the original head
Small flank geodes
Opaque faceted quartz treatment; no refractive/transparency shader
